mapper.update: UPDATE PRJ_WRK_TM_CRTR_INFO_TBL SET WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_TP = ( CASE WHEN (#{wrkTmMeasCrtrTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{wrkTmMeasCrtrTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_TP ELSE #{wrkTmMeasCrtrTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , USE_YN = ( CASE WHEN (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN USE_YN ELSE #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_NM = ( CASE WHEN (#{wrkTmMeasCrtrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{wrkTmMeasCrtrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_NM ELSE #{wrkTmMeasCrtrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_DGR = ( CASE WHEN (#{wrkTmMeasCrtrDgr, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{wrkTmMeasCrtrDgr, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_DGR ELSE #{wrkTmMeasCrtrDgr, jdbcType=NUMERIC} END ) , WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_VAL = ( CASE WHEN (#{wrkTmMeasCrtrVal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{wrkTmMeasCrtrVal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_VAL ELSE #{wrkTmMeasCrtrVal, jdbcType=NUMERIC} END ) , WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_DESC = ( CASE WHEN (#{wrkTmMeasCrtrDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{wrkTmMeasCrtrDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN WRK_TM_MEAS_CRTR_DESC ELSE #{wrkTmMeasCrtrDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) , UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) , UPDT_SEQ = ( CASE WHEN (#{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL OR #{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0) THEN UPDT_SEQ ELSE #{updtSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} END ) , UPDT_NM = ( CASE WHEN (#{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR #{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '') THEN UPDT_NM ELSE #{updtNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} END ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (WRK_TM_CRTR_SEQ = #{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (WRK_TM_CRTR_CD = #{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
mapper.delete: UPDATE PRJ_WRK_TM_CRTR_INFO_TBL SET USE_YN = 'N' , DELT_YN = 'Y' , DELT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) , DELT_SEQ = #{deltSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} , DELT_NM = #{deltNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE 1 = 1 AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND (((#{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (WRK_TM_CRTR_SEQ = #{wrkTmCrtrSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (WRK_TM_CRTR_CD = #{wrkTmCrtrCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
